messages:
maya (PM): Heads up — I'm proposing a timeline pivot: shift the extended telemetry & per-tenant QoS work to v1, keep a narrower MVP focused on stable inference + rollout tooling. Need quick buy-in so we can freeze scope for the sprint.

sam (eng): Agree on narrowing. Two quick Qs: which infra items are mandatory for MVP? and any customer-driven asks that absolutely block launch?

maya (PM): Mandatory for MVP: 1) stable hosted inference endpoint with canary rollout, 2) basic batching & cache config, 3) model pinning and versioning support, 4) rollout dashboard (errors + latency). Non-blocking for MVP (move to v1): per-tenant QoS, full telemetry retention (90d), advanced autoscale policies.

rachel (cs): +1 for moving telemetry to v1. Biggest customers are asking for per-tenant limits, but they said it can wait if we have clear SLAs and rollout controls. They prefer predictable latency over detailed logs initially.

li (eng-infra): Technical constraint: moving per-tenant QoS reduces scope but we still need a lightweight rate limiter for safety — 429s for extreme bursts. That can be a simple token-bucket that ships in MVP.

nate (design): For the rollout dashboard, can we scope MVP to a single page with: latency P90, error rate, active model version, and last deploy? No fancy UX for traces until v1.

sam (eng): Token-bucket + minimal dashboard sounds doable in sprint. We should also mark quantization recommendation tooling as v1 — that reduces near-term kernel work.

maya (PM): Good. I'll update the milestone doc: set MVP feature set to the four must-haves and the lightweight safety limiter. Everything else moves to v1 bucket unless a customer explicitly requires it before GA. Action: sam to confirm effort estimate, li to scope token-bucket, nate to produce 1-pg dashboard mock by EOD Tue.

sam (eng): Will estimate by EOD today. One caveat: the canary rollout backend needs a rollback path in the same sprint or we can't guarantee GA readiness.

li (eng-infra): We can provide a rollback switch and traffic split control in the runtime. Estimate 2 dev days + 1 test day.

rachel (cs): I'll tell the top two customers about the plan and get firm timelines on their QoS requests. If either pushes hard, we'll re-triage.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging/rollout-dashboard-feature -> Wed 02:00 UTC (dry run)

maya (PM): OK — next steps summarized: 1) Sam: implementation estimate + confirm rollback path (by EOD). 2) Li: token-bucket plan + test matrix. 3) Nate: dashboard mock (EOD Tue). 4) Rachel: customer alignment. I'll update milestone tracker and propose a timeline reset if estimates push us >2 weeks. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
